decision: Pause additional StoryBox rule/mechanic expansion as the default path. Introduce a separate Strategic Cognition Kernel (SCK) between StoryBox visibility/legal-action state and StoryBox hard-world resolution, and require external benchmark evidence before claiming that the system can produce high-skill games.
reasoning: StoryBox already has world/event-arc/game/scene/round/action structure, fixed truth, information isolation, convergence and moderator rules.
The remaining quality gap is primarily actor cognition: belief calibration, opponent modeling, counterfactual planning, communication strategy and self-play improvement.
External projects such as AvalonBench/Strategist, TextArena, Cicero, AIWolf-style arenas and Werewolf platforms demonstrate that game legality alone is insufficient for high-skill play.
SCK must be benchmarkable outside the novel so that apparent intelligence is not judged only by prose quality.

before_mcts_or_bilevel_search: run shared-seed 50-episode A/B smoke test across plain/memory/belief/belief_planning
show measurable improvement in win/utility or action regret without materially worse calibration/leakage
gate.before_story_prose_claims_high_skill: SCK must demonstrate external or replay benchmark advantage; prose fluency is not evidence of strategic skill.
